wake-of-gods.mapobjects.arcanetower.name: Arcane Tower
wake-of-gods.mapobjects.arcanetower.desc: Exchange one primary skill point for another. Each accepted trade costs 300 movement points. You can revisit. Remove equipment that modifies primary skills before trading.
wake-of-gods.mapobjects.arcanetower.trad:
{Arcane Tower}

A ghost floats down a staircase and glides up to you. It floats there, flickering, regarding you. At last it speaks. "It is well that you came here, traveller. I can help you."

The ghost continues. "I can make you strong, give you power - perhaps as much power as I have! But it will cost you dearly. I can give you skill at attack, defense, spellcasting, or knowledge... in return, I require the same. One for one. Are you interested?"

I can grant you 1 point of Attack. "Will you pay me with your defense skill?"

Gain +1 Attack, give up 1 Defence. Cost: 300 movement points.
Only trade points you have without artifacts or temporary bonuses.
